name: Monash interest-free student loan
summary: Interest-free loans for domestic and international Monash students whose finances are affecting their ability to keep studying.
who: You must be studying at an Australian campus.
Your financial situation must be affecting your ability to continue studying.
You're not eligible if you're on intermission (study leave).
catches: Can't be used for amenities fees, course fees or visa charges.
The page doesn't state a loan limit.

evidence.claim: Domestic and international students can apply
evidence.quote: Both domestic and international students can apply for an interest-free loan.
your financial situation must be affecting your ability to continue studying.
